name: Sage
description: Sage has soft grey-green leaves and a bold, savory fragrance.
usefulInformation: Delicious in browned butter, beans and autumn dishes.
healthBenefits: Contains plant antioxidants; high-dose medicinal preparations can pose risks.
medicinalUses: Traditionally prepared as tea; avoid concentrated sage oil internally.

additionalInformation.growingTips: Grow in well-drained soil and adjust watering and sunlight to local conditions.
additionalInformation.harvesting: Harvest gently, leaving enough growth for the plant to recover.
additionalInformation.gardenNote: A useful addition to a kitchen and pollinator-friendly herb garden.
